how_it_works.title: How BitTasker Works
how_it_works.subtitle: Your guide to using the world's first Bitcoin-powered freelance marketplace

hero.description: BitTasker connects skilled professionals with people who need tasks done. Our Bitcoin-powered platform makes hiring, working, and getting paid simple, secure, and borderless.

overview.title: The BitTasker Process
overview.description: From signup to payment, our platform makes it easy to find work, hire taskees, and complete tasks with confidence and security

alert.title: New to BitTasker?
alert.description: Our platform uses secure passkeys instead of passwords and Bitcoin-powered secure payment contracts for all payments, providing a safer experience than traditional platforms.

step_1.title: Sign Up with BitTasker
step_1.description: Create your BitTasker account using our secure passkey system – no passwords needed! Our modern authentication approach uses your device's biometric security (fingerprint or face recognition) to keep your account safe.

quick_secure.title: Quick and Secure
quick_secure.item_2: No password to remember or risk being stolen

requirements.title: What You'll Need
requirements.item_2: Optional: recovery email for account backup

step_1.security_note: Learn more about our security approach and how we protect your account better than traditional password-based platforms.

step_2.title: Create Your Professional Profile
step_2.description: Your profile is your digital reputation on BitTasker. Whether you're hiring or being hired, a complete profile builds trust and increases your chances of success on the platform.

skills.title: Skills & Expertise
skills.description: Highlight what you do best. Be specific about your skills so taskees can find you for the right tasks.

experience.title: Experience & Portfolio
experience.description: Share your work history, qualifications, and examples of previous projects to establish credibility.

rates.title: Rates & Availability
rates.description: Set your hourly or project-based rates, and use our calendar system to manage your available working hours.

payments.title: Payment Methods
payments.description: Begin accepting payments immediately with our built-in wallets.

step_2.tip: Pro tip: Profiles with a profile photo, verified skills, and complete information get up to 5x more work opportunities. Take time to make yours stand out!

step_3.title: Find Tasks or Talent
step_3.description: BitTasker matches people who need help with people who want work.

for_taskers.title: I need help: post a job, get offers

1.title: Describe your task
1.description: Be specific about what you need, when you need it, and your budget.

2.title: Review offers from qualified taskees
2.description: Compare skills, ratings, and price quotes to find the perfect match.

3.title: Hire and pay through secure payment contracts
3.description: Our secure payment contract system protects both parties during the transaction.

for_taskers.tip: Budget Tip: Set a realistic budget range for your project with our fixed-price payment model. Be as detailed and accurate as possible with your tasks to ensure accurate bids and avoid rescopes from taskees.

for_taskees.title: I want work: find a job that fits

1.title: Browse available tasks
1.description: Filter by category, location, budget, and project type to find your ideal match.

2.title: Send compelling offers
2.description: Explain why you're perfect for the job, your approach, timeline, and pricing.

3.title: Negotiate and accept terms
3.description: When hired, you'll receive clear tasks, milestones, and payment terms through our platform.

for_taskees.tip: Success Tip: Customize each proposal instead of sending generic responses. Taskers are more likely to hire taskees who address their specific needs.

step_4.title: Complete the Work
step_4.description: BitTasker provides all the tools you need to successfully complete projects, track progress, and maintain clear communication throughout.

messaging.title: End-to-End Encrypted Messaging
messaging.description: Direct messages open only after escrow is formed, and only between the hirer and the worker. Until then, use the bid. Phone numbers, email, and outside links in a bid are blocked.

files.title: File Sharing
files.description: Securely exchange documents, images, and files necessary for project completion.

milestones.title: Milestone Tracking
milestones.description: Break projects into manageable milestones with individual secure payment contracts for each completed phase.

translation.title: Automatic Translation
translation.description: Communicate in your own language while messages are automatically translated for the other user, breaking down language barriers.

completion.title: Task Completion
completion.description: The worker submits the work. The hirer approves it. The worker requests payment. The hirer pays that invoice. This usually takes a few minutes.

step_4.warning: Important: Always communicate through the BitTasker platform to ensure protection under our community guidelines and dispute resolution process.

step_5.title: Get paid in Bitcoin, USDT, or Lightning
step_5.description: The hirer can lock Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or a Lightning payment. You can also buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer. The provider takes the card. The bitcoin is paid to your own address. BitTasker does not see the card.

feature_1.title: Secure Payment Contract System
feature_1.description: Tasker funds are secured in our secure payment contract system until work is approved, protecting both parties throughout the transaction regardless of payment method.

feature_2.title: You pay after you approve
feature_2.description: Nothing is paid on a timer. After the hirer approves the work, the worker requests payment and the hirer pays that invoice.

feature_3.title: Flexible Withdrawal Options
feature_3.description: Send Bitcoin or USDT from this wallet, or pay a Lightning invoice. A card or bank purchase buys bitcoin to your own address. There is no in-app swap.

step_5.alert: Fee Advantage: BitTasker's dynamic fee structure rewards active users with progressively lower fees. The more you use the platform, the less you pay!
